description:
Org-mode viewer and task manager
Emborg lets you browse .org files on your device, view them with lightweight Org-aware formatting, and manage TODO items across all your files from a single task list.

Features:

- Browse and open .org files from any folder, via the Storage Access Framework
- Formatted viewer for Org markup: headings, paragraphs, lists, bold, italic, links
- Cross-file task list aggregating TODO items from all your .org files
- Task editor for TODO state, tags, and notes
- Light and dark themes
- Fully offline: no network access, no analytics, no ads, no tracking
